hypothesis: Changing only the nominal entry budget from 250 to 125 dollars will reduce maximum episode marked drawdown to at most 60% of the parent's, improve mean net episode profit by at least 0.25 dollars on the 33 reused public episodes t=20..52, keep identical entry-signal counts with at least three fills and zero rejections. Otherwise retain the parent. This is a sizing/risk hypothesis, not a new predictive-alpha claim.
selection_rule: Revise offline source iff all stated criteria pass; otherwise retain. One proposal, no parameter sweep.
provenance: Declared before this run, after reviewing scoreboard and old development report. The prior negative mean makes half-sizing expected to improve this reused path; this is a mechanistic risk ablation, not an unbiased predictive discovery.
